hooks.text: 从驾驶飞船无缝切到太空行走和地表探索，战斗与移动不断换场
hooks.excerpt: Once you’ve jumped with your ship, you can switch seamlessly between operating your ship, space walking and on-foot planetary exploration, it just works.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 搜刮零件维修改装飞船，并在防御、速度能量与攻击之间分配性能
hooks.excerpt: Manage your ship as you scavenge for parts to upgrade or repair it, and adapt it to fit your needs. Bolster your arsenal of guns and components with tons of modifiers. Fly with a crew, or go solo - Jump Space is best enjoyed with friends, but solo adventurers are welcome too. Manage Your Jump Ship Upgrade and customise your ship and guns as you face off against the challenges of space exploration, and scavenge resources to ensure your survival. Reinforce your defences, adjust your energy output for speed or bolster your ship’s attack capabilities - the choice is yours.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 没有固定职业，队员临场承担驾驶、工程和外勤并处理火灾与电网
hooks.excerpt: Go on missions with your friends and take on roles, from piloting to engineering and field exploration. Work together to overcome enemy attacks, extinguish fires on the command deck or adjust your ship’s power grid on the fly. There are no set classes in Jump Space, improvise and decide how you want to engage.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
